about.heading: About the Team
about.subhead: Stoned Goose Productions is a crew of producers, performers, and media pros building cinematic comedy experiences across the Pacific Northwest.

pillars.title: Production & Ops
pillars.body: Producers, bookers, and stage managers who keep tours, residencies, and monthly showcases running smoothly.

pillars.title: Media Team
pillars.body: Cinematographers, editors, and photographers crafting specials, podcast visuals, and crisp headshots for every comic.

pillars.title: Community & Partners
pillars.body: Venue partners, sponsors, and collaborators who help us elevate Pacific Northwest comedy together.

pillars.title: Creative Lab
pillars.body: Writers and creative directors shaping new formats, themed shows, and social content that keeps audiences engaged.
